title: Literally smells like vomit. Looks ok
text: Literally smells like vomit. Looks ok. These have a vomit smell right out of the bag. I’m hoping it fades. But it must be indicative of the gross chemicals used to create and pack this. The leaves are a little too large in my opinion. The variegated colors on leaf and the quantity you get is nice. All the leaves were attached.
